user.title: NS Reisadvies
user.description: Configure a route between two Dutch railway stations. You will need a free NS API subscription key from apiportal.ns.nl.

data_description.api_key: Your NS API subscription key. Only required on the first route; subsequent routes reuse it.
data_description.act_station: The station where the journey starts.
data_description.arr_station: The station where the journey ends.

error.same_station: The departure and arrival station must be different.
error.unknown_station: That is not a recognised Dutch railway station — pick one from the list.

data_description.api_key: Your NS API subscription key. Replace if it has been rotated.
data_description.scan_interval_minuten: How often the integration polls the NS API. Allowed range: 1 to 60.
data_description.fav_hours: How long to keep a pinned favourite before it is removed automatically. Set to 0 to disable expiry.
data_description.fetch_composition: Adds an extra NS API call per unique train per refresh to retrieve the actual carriage composition (number of carriages, rolling-stock type, image). Off by default to save API quota.

track_trip.name: Pin trip as favourite
track_trip.description: Pin a trip on the targeted NS Reisadvies sensor. The trip stays visible until the favourite retention expires or until it is unpinned.

ctx_recon.name: ctxRecon
ctx_recon.description: The ctxRecon string of the trip to pin. Visible as trip.ctxRecon in the sensor attributes.

untrack_trip.name: Unpin trip
untrack_trip.description: Remove a previously pinned trip from the favourites list of the targeted sensor.

ctx_recon.name: ctxRecon
ctx_recon.description: The ctxRecon string of the trip to unpin.

no_api_key.message: No NS API key has been configured for this entry.

api_status.message: The NS travel advice API returned status {status}.

api_unreachable.message: Could not reach the NS API: {error}.
